---
title: "Community - Highscores"
format: html
---

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Experience

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")
players <- dbReadTable(con, "players")
daily_snapshots <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_snapshots")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get latest snapshots
latest_snapshots <- daily_snapshots |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  filter(snapshot_date == max(snapshot_date)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004))

level_lb <- latest_snapshots |>
  left_join(players, by = c("player_id" = "id")) |>
  select(player_id, name, level, experience) |>
  arrange(desc(level), desc(experience)) |>
  head(100) |>
  mutate(
    Rank = row_number(),
    Name = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/characters/', player_id, '.html" ',
      'style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      name,
      '</a>'
    ),
    Level = level,
    Experience = format(experience, big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  select(Rank, Name, Level, Experience)

DT::datatable(level_lb,
          options = list(pageLength = 20, searching = TRUE, ordering = FALSE),
          rownames = FALSE,
          escape = FALSE)
```
